```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  var images = ['images/welcome1.jpg', 'images/welcome2.jpg'];
  var randomImg = images[Math.floor(Math.random() * images.length)];
  var hero = document.querySelector('.welcome-hero');
  if (hero) {
    hero.style.backgroundImage = 'linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.35), rgba(255,255,255,0.45)), url("' + randomImg + '")';
    hero.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
    hero.style.backgroundPosition = 'center 25%';
    hero.style.backgroundRepeat = 'no-repeat';
  }
});
</script>
```
